question: Does an author-based TabM pipeline improve compliant development detection or cost beyond current strong baselines under the same target-label budget?
task: historically supervised C2 detection after complete Zeek flow availability

input.ports: audit only; excluded from target C2 learned candidates, not a universal policy
input.missing: restore -1, fit-only median imputation, separate binary mask per continuous field
input.transform: nonnegative log1p followed by fit-only StandardScaler; no quantile clipping

training.final_refit: fit P once from scratch at V-selected epoch or stage; refit preprocessing on P; no second selection on V

historical_references: R26 target ports_zero8 HGB and all MLP seeds
primary_detection_reference: new HGB under identical P/C information and row weights
legacy_capability_reference: old HGB with original threshold union fixed UDP443 duration30s rule

development_candidate_requirement.qualification: FP <= floor(0.01 * normal_rows) in every B and D cell; B TP total = 72
development_candidate_requirement.comparison: For each reference, TP must not decrease in any reference-qualified cell. At least one D cell must strictly improve qualified TP or repair reference FPR failure.
development_candidate_requirement.seeds: each of 17, 29, 43 must satisfy all conditions
development_candidate_requirement.over_budget_reference: report raw TPs; they are not an obligatory qualified-TP bound
development_candidate_requirement.identity_losses: report all added and lost TP identities even when per-cell counts do not decrease
development_candidate_requirement.cost_tradeoff: report; no automatic adoption based on undefined similar-detection tolerance

PLE_detection_benefit: Same-seed full vs no-PLE at final fixed C thresholds: full is qualified in every B/D cell, no TP drop in any ablation-qualified cell, and at least one D cell improves qualification or qualified TP, consistently for all three seeds. V pAUC alone is insufficient.

outcomes.all_seed_real_gain: development candidate only; report each cell and added/lost old TPs; independent confirmation separate
outcomes.pauc_only_or_fpr_failure: no deployment-gain claim; no E/D threshold search
outcomes.ple_no_gain: retain negative ablation; no bin or embedding-size sweep
outcomes.hgb_wins_or_tabm_fails: retain HGB as reference; close this neural branch; if HGB violates budgets, no newly qualified deployment model exists
outcomes.detection_cost_tradeoff: report all detection and cost outcomes including preprocessing and memory; no automatic adoption rule
outcomes.missing_matched_normal_business: limit claims to observed business; no general C2/download claim

execution_scope: Future implementation binds raw identities, hashes and artifacts before laboratory execution. This JSON is not an executable lab registration.
